title: TDD Kata Companion
description: Runnable Vitest 3 kata: the password validator and FizzBuzz examples from the TDD guide, plus a self-check script that walks red-green-refactor step by step.
description_es: Kata ejecutable con Vitest 3: el validador de contraseña y FizzBuzz de la guía TDD, más un script que recorre el ciclo red-green-refactor paso a paso.
